description:
Engineered real-time multiplayer systems and high-performance gameplay mechanics for production-scale gaming environments.
Optimized physics simulations and graphics pipeline performance, yielding a stable 60 FPS target across mobile and WebGL platforms.
Implemented state-synchronization protocols to minimize latency and ensure consistent multiplayer client state.
